findings.summary: When payment fields have errors but no form-level error is rendered, focus has no error target and does not move to the first invalid field.
findings.fix: After checking [data-error-focus], focus the first invalid payment control before falling back to errorSummary or statusSummary.
findings.evidence: Payment field errors set aria-invalid and aria-describedby, but the script only focuses data-error-focus, data-error-summary, or data-status-summary.

findings.summary: Static unlinked-payment notices use role=status despite not reporting a live update, adding unnecessary status-region semantics.
findings.fix: Remove role=status from static financial notices while retaining it for action-result messages.
findings.evidence: Unlinked completed-payment notices were rendered as role=status.

passed: Unread counts are included in the notification navigation link's accessible name; the visual badge is hidden as duplicate content.
Fee reminders and payment-status notifications persist and render readable titles, messages, timestamps, and types.
